## Site Name
Healthcare & Clinic (MediCare) — A NorthWeb.co Demo

## Purpose
A professional clinic website with doctor profiles, appointment booking, and patient resources.

## Industry
Healthcare / Medical

## Key Features
- Expert Doctors: Board-certified specialists across 15+ medical disciplines.
- Easy Appointments: Book in-clinic or teleconsultation appointments online, 24/7.
- Digital Prescriptions: Secure digital prescriptions and lab reports accessible anytime.
- Modern Facilities: State-of-the-art diagnostic equipment and clean, safe environments.
- 24/7 Helpline: Round-the-clock helpline for medical emergencies and queries.
- Patient Privacy: All patient data handled with full DPDPA 2023 compliance.

## Data Compliance
DPDPA 2023 (India) compliant. Data collected: name, email address, phone number, appointment date and time, department/speciality preference, brief description of symptoms (optional).
